shared_elements: animal in profile with legs (quadruped-like creature)
shallow-relief / incised carving on a rough stone surface
row of short parallel strokes forming a comb- or fringe-like band
elongated linear body with projecting appendages
scale/measurement markers placed on the surface for documentation
justification: Both surfaces carry animal-like figures rendered by cutting into stone, and each contains a comb-like sequence of short parallel strokes projecting from a longer line, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a crisply modelled, deeply carved pillar with figures stacked in clear horizontal registers, while B is a flat, weathered panel bearing a single sprawling, shallow, faintly pecked outline with no register system or comparable ordering.
